summary: The change covers all three items in #18. Each item has a case that was seen failing before its fix, plus a neighbouring case that must not change. Every edit stays above the template body, so the template version stays at v2, and the hand-written gate shapes are built as sed copies of the one Laravel fixture. The one finding is a small regression in the reader's docs regex: making the `(default ...)` tail optional also made it stop at the first `)`, so a default that holds a parenthesis ends up in the doc and breaks the round trip back to checks.json. No scheduled or queued work touches these files.

findings.title: Docs regex cuts the default at its first ')', so the default leaks into the doc
findings.description: The new docs regex ends with an optional tail, `(?:\s+\(default [^)]*\))?\s*$`, and the character class stops at the first `)`. checks.json validation (lines 660-661) refuses only `" $ ` \ }` in a var's default, so a default can hold a parenthesis, for example a DSN like `user@tcp(127.0.0.1:3306)/db`. On such a line the tail cannot reach the end of the line, so it is skipped. The lazy doc group then runs to the end and takes in ` (default user@tcp(127.0.0.1:3306)/db)`. `read-checks` returns that text as the doc, and regenerating from `input` prints the default twice (`scratch DSN (default ...) (default ...)`), which breaks the round trip that README line 227 and the setup test's "input recovers the whole checks.json" case describe. The pattern before this PR, `(.*?) \(default (.*)\)\s*$`, took the default greedily and read these lines correctly. So this is a regression for the new `ENV=<name>` lines and also for headers generated before #18. Reproduced with the same patterns under PCRE2, because the guard does not let the reviewer run the script or python3. The test line is `#   REDLINE_OLD=old_name   doc of a pre-#18 line (default a)b)`: the old pattern gives `doc of a pre-#18 line`, and the new one gives `doc of a pre-#18 line (default a)b)`. With `#   REDLINE_DSN=<name>   scratch DSN (default mysql:host=127.0.0.1;dbname=x(y))`, the new pattern gives the doc `scratch DSN (default mysql:host=127.0.0.1;dbname=x(y))`.
findings.proposedFix: Make the tail greedy, as the old pattern's `\(default (.*)\)` was: `^#   ([A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)=(?:<name>|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+(.*?)(?:\s+\(default .*\))?\s*$`. The lazy doc group still stops at the first ` (default `. On the sample lines it gives `scratch database for the migrations check`, `port of the scratch server`, `scratch DSN` and `doc of a pre-#18 line`, and the line with no default still gives its whole doc. Add a setup-test case before the fix, which should fail first: `sed 's#(default chalkboard_redline_migrate)$#(default tcp(db)/x)#' "$LC" > "$WORK/paren-default.sh"`, then `expect_json "read-checks: a default holding a parenthesis stays out of the doc (#18)" '.input.vars[0].doc' "scratch database for the migrations check" read-checks "$WORK/paren-default.sh"`.
